caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its onboard Left Navigation Camera (Navcam). The camera is located high on the rover's mast and aids in driving. 

This image was acquired on Jan. 22, 2023 (Sol 684) at the local mean solar time of 13:23:49.

geolocation.basis: Rover site 32 / drive 1062 localization record matched to the image's site/drive metadata
geolocation.distance_note: This image's site/drive record (32/1062) is ~55 m (ground distance, east-west scaled by cos(latitude)) from the site's anchor record (32/250) used for 'Three Forks Sample Depot'.
